name: Personalized Piggy Bank
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

Available in three material styles to suit your aesthetic preference:

 - Full Wooden – warm, rustic look with natural textures

 - Full Acrylic – sleek, modern, and transparent

 - Mixed – a combination of acrylic + wood for a unique layered effect

All materials are 3mm thick, durable, and precision-cut for easy assembly.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Choose from two size options (Assembled Dimensions):

- Small: 6 × 6 inches ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm

 - Medium: 8 × 8 inches ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm

 - Box Depth (for both sizes): 4.33 inches ~ 11 cm

Easy Assembly: Requires simple self-assembly by interlocking the pre-cut wood or acrylic pieces—no tools or glue needed.

 

  • Construction Details:

- Front & Back Panels: Made from either wood or acrylic.

- Front Panel: Double-layered for 3D depth and durability. Choose between: 2 wood layers or 2 acrylic layers or 1 wood + 1 acrylic layer.

- Back Panel: Single-layered (wood or acrylic)

- Side Panels: Laser-cut wooden pieces interlock to form a durable box frame.

- Top Slot: For inserting coins, folded cash, envelopes, or notes.

 

  • Printing Technology:

- Printed on both sides with UV printing technology for high-resolution, vibrant, and fade-resistant imagery.

- Add custom names, artwork, or quotes to personalize your gift.

 

  • Functional & Decorative:

- Not just a piggy bank! It also works as a keepsake memory box, motivational savings jar, or event money envelope holder. 

- Ideal for: Kids learning to save, Displaying on shelves or desks, Collecting notes or money gifts for special events.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- Makes a meaningful gift for: Baby showers, Birthdays, Christmas & holidays, Graduations, Or any personalized occasion.

- Suitable for all ages – from kids to adults!

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xPersonalized Piggy Bank

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
